decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several specialized and general-purpose backpacks. The DeMarini (baseball) and BASSDASH (fishing) bags were high-quality but too niche for a general-purpose need. The FOCO NFL bag had some concerns regarding zipper durability in similar models. The MOSISO sling was a good compact option, but the ZOMAKE 30/35/45L packable backpack stood out as the best overall value. One reviewer mentioned it was their 13th purchase from the brand, which is a strong signal of reliability and customer loyalty. For under $17, its versatility for travel and hiking makes it the most practical choice.
